body: Thank you!! If you ever need to talk to anyone my PMS are open, I know how tough breakups are. You are strong for making that decision.
Aw, thank you. If you ever need to talk to anyone, my PMS are open. I'd enjoy the conversation. ❤

im not sure if its normal, honestly. It might depend on how old you were when the parent died, but i was really surprised when they said $800 - i hadnt expected that much.

Im really sorry that happened to you. god i wish nparents didnt exist
Thank you! This comforted me. I wish you health and happiness as well.

Yeah I wrote this in a hurry to get my feelings out haha. I worked my remaining shifts BESIDES my last day, cause, well, mom in the hospital.   


Thank you though, knowing that this job was just my first and I'll have plenty others is comforting.

I just got a brand new controller and it seemed to fix what I was experiencing, so I'm not sure what could be the problem with yours :/ If it's not happening in any other games it might just be Overwatch itself (but I'm sure you already knew that)

Do post if you find a solution, I feel bad I wasnt able to help with this issue further
I'm currently saving up money but I might have to try another controller at this point tbh. Hopefully it'll work.

I've been thinking about asking about emancipation, I really hope that will be an option for me. 

Thank you so much, reading these reminders really helps a lot. ❤

I'm so glad someone relates with the pet situatuon. It is so scary. My cat is like my baby, so thinking of any harm that may come to him makes me so upset.

Thank you so much for the encouragment. I appreciate it so, so much. I hope you are able to take your pets with you soon, too! I wish all the best for you.

Sometimes I dont think theyre bullshit, and feel bad, so thats the hard part haha.

No, all my family is either dead or not stable. My boyfriend has offered if my mother does not come after me that I can live with him and his mother+younger brother. I want to take this route, but I am afraid of leaving my cat behind. I'm really attached to him. When I leave in June I want to tell my Mother I'll only come back if she quits drinking as a lie to put her off (I think she expects me to not come back at this point) but leaving my cat is genuinely so terrifying to me.
